questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No customer is manager.

All salesmen are managers.

**Conclusions:**

I. No salesman is customer.

II. Some managers are salesmen.

III. Some salesmen are customers.

options.text: Only conclusion I and II follow.
Either conclusion I or III follows.
Only conclusion I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8d44591ff41d117b6077b1645ce158b5dd6d28c6e18c1b63cd3f4ebe2a3bc83.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No salesman is customer → True (All salesman are Manager and No manager is a customer Therefore no salesman can be a customer)

II. Some managers are salesmen → True (All Salesman are Manager. Thus, some manager are Salesman)

III. Some salesmen are customers → False ((All salesman are Manager and No manager is a customer Therefore no salesman can be a customer)

Hence, only conclusion I and II follows.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All liquids are solids.

All gases are solids.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some solids are liquids.

II. Some liquids are gases.

III. No liquid is gas.

options.text: Conclusion I and either conclusion II or III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.
Conclusion II and either conclusion I or III follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a213d6126f31357c76a629e72bfa024f9ec144fe344df4fce3ba67355e9b90b6.png] 

**Conclusion:**

I. Some solids are liquids → True (All liquids are solids so some solids are also liquids)

II. Some liquids are gases → False (No relation is given between them so some liquids are gases dose not follow)

III. No liquid is gas → False (Again no relation between them so no liquid is gas also does not follow)

Conclusion II and III does not follow but the statement is same and both are false so either of them follow.

Hence, conclusion I and either conclusion II or III follow.

questions.question: Three batsmen Anjana, Yamini and Gargi made a total of 99 runs in a cricket match. Anjana made runs equal to one third of the runs made by Gargi. Gargi made just double the number of runs made by Yamini. How many runs did Anjana make in that match?
questions.solution:
According to statement, Anjana, Yamini and Gargi made 99 runs in a cricket match.

Gargi made double runs from Yamini. We let Yamini score is X and Gargi score 2X

Yamini – x runs

Gargi – 2x runs

Anjana made runs equal to one third runs made by Gargi means Anjana score = 2x/3 runs.

Now the equation is,

x + 2x + 2x/3 = 99

11x = 297

x = 27

Yamini score = 27,

Gargi score = 2 × 27 = 54,

Anjana score = 54/3 = 18 runs.

Hence, the correct answer is 18.

questions.question: Kelvin and Kartik are sitting with their backs towards each other. At the time of sunset, if the shadow of Kartik falls exactly to his right side, then which direction is Kelvin facing?

Select the correct alternative to indicate the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Filtration and boiling

2. Cooling and solidifying

3. Sugarcane production

4. Jaggery making

5. Juice extraction
questions.solution:
First we have Sugarcane production then Juice extraction after that Filtration and boiling

Now Cooling and solidifying and finally Jaggery making.

Sugarcane production → Juice extraction → Filtration and boiling → Cooling and solidifying → Jaggery making

Hence, the correct answer is 3, 5, 1, 2, 4.
